intro: Amity University Noida is in Noida and Noida International University is in Greater Noida. This page compares their recorded Mass Communication (PG) fees, placements, admission routes and campuses for 2026.

Amity University Noida vs Noida International University is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: Amity University Noida vs Noida International University for Mass Communication (PG): which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Amity University Noida if its Mass Communication (PG) programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose Noida International University if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.
Amity University Noida lists Master of Journalism and Mass Communication. Noida International University lists M.A (Journalism & Mass Communication).

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹1.72 lakh a year as tuition fees for Amity University Noida's Master of Journalism and Mass Communication. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹72,000 a year as total fees for Noida International University's M.A (Journalism & Mass Communication). Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, Amity University Noida's 2023 figures are an average of ₹7 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh for Master of Journalism and Mass Communication. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, Noida International University's 2023 figures are an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹14 lakh for M.A (Journalism & Mass Communication). These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Amity University Noida's recorded admission tests on this page include CUET PG.
Noida International University's recorded admission tests on this page include CUET PG.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: There is no universal winner in Amity University Noida vs Noida International University for Mass Communication (PG). Use the programme list, the official fee notice and the admission test to decide.
